speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Suboptimal Intake Jaundice)

The clinical picture of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with high unconjugated bilirubin (Total 16.1, Direct 0.7) and a normal blood type strongly points to inadequate feeding rather than hemolysis. To confirm this, I need to assess the feeding frequency and stool output. Has the baby been breastfeeding every 2-3 hours, and are you seeing at least 6 wet diapers and 3-4 meconium stools per day?
